functions.name: award_badge
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.award_badge(p_user_id uuid, p_badge_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_badge_id UUID;
  v_is_public BOOLEAN;
  v_new_id    UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve badge key to id (only active badges)
  SELECT id
  INTO v_badge_id
  FROM badge_definitions
  WHERE key       = p_badge_key
    AND is_active = true;

  -- Badge not found or inactive
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN FALSE;
  END IF;

  -- Determine default visibility.
  -- night_owl and early_bird are private by default (sensitive schedule info).
  v_is_public := CASE
    WHEN p_badge_key IN ('night_owl', 'early_bird') THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END;

  -- Idempotent insert: silently ignore if badge already earned.
  -- ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is race-condition safe without explicit locking.
  INSERT INTO user_badges (user_id, badge_id, earned_at, notified, is_public)
  VALUES (p_user_id, v_badge_id, NOW(), FALSE, v_is_public)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, badge_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;

  -- Return TRUE only if a new row was inserted (i.e. badge was newly earned)
  RETURN v_new_id IS NOT NULL;
END;
$function$
